summary: No security impact. The change adds a hero-preflop-line check for postflop graded examples in src/advice/golden.ts (golden-example validator), re-authors three entries in tests/golden/graded-examples.json, adds an acceptance test, and updates docs. The only input is repo-controlled test JSON (spec §8 trust boundary); messages still go through the existing echo helper. Replacing `if (!result.ok) break;` with a cast to the ApplyResult success branch is safe because heroPreflopProblems runs only after the view build has already checked that every step is legal; if that invariant ever broke, the failure would be a thrown TypeError in test validation (fails closed), not a security issue. No new dependencies, network, secrets, randomness, file or shell operations.
